I replied to Kwame in your DM: I can't run a 09:00 digest on a timer. Nothing will arrive tomorrow unless he asks for it.

I can build a "Coastal team digest" on request. I'd read #coastal-team (he is a member) and list what's new since the last one. Kwame has not asked for a digest yet, so I haven't read the channel.

One correction to my reply: I said a scheduled job would need an admin to set it up. I didn't check that. The scheduling tool here saves jobs locally and doesn't deliver output to this DM, so a timed digest here isn't possible either way. A scheduled job would need a delivery channel that reaches Kwame.
